_comment: Out-of-scope prompts for evals/ci/routing_eval.py. Every one of these should route to `none`. The skill eval sets in skills/*/evals/ only contain prompts that DO belong to a skill, so on their own they can only detect a skill that stops attracting its own work — they are blind to a description that gets greedier and starts claiming prompts it should not. The `hard` cases deliberately share vocabulary with the skills (dashboard, revenue, model, query, semantic layer) while targeting another tool entirely; those are where over-triggering shows up first.
